A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a 50 Mev electron beam with 1.5 nC charge per pulse can be injected into the ALPHA storage ring with the debunching scheme, and a 1 nC beam per pulse can be accumulated with the beam accumulation scheme.

the injection and extraction systems are designed to have a maximum beam transmission of 95% and to satisfy a beam current of 1.0 mA, a bunch length of 2 ns and a beam size of 2 mm (rms) at the target.

a 20 MeV beam can be injected into the ring with a beam size of 0.5 mm (rms) at the center of the injection beamline, and the beam is extracted with a beam size smaller than 1 mm (rms) after passing the Lambertson magnet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of the injection and extraciton beamlines is not trivial, but can be done by considering the beam dynamics and optics.
the beam transport is optimized by considering the beam optics in the whole beamlines.
the injection and extraction optics should be designed to minimize beam emittance growth, which is caused by the magnetic kickers.
